::: {.callout-note}
### Interactive Tag Filtering
Use the **Categories** filter sidebar on the right (or tap Categories on mobile) to filter the collection by semantic domain, part of speech, or conceptual register (e.g., `Vocabulary`, `Lexical-Deep-Dive`, `Grammar`, `Negotiation`, `Debate`, `Chaos-vs-Order`, `Epistemic-States`). You can also use the live search bar above the table to search for any word, root, or concept.
:::
